annotations.title: Validate an e-invoice (EN 16931, XRechnung, Peppol BIS)

description:
Validate an EU e-invoice XML (UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII, e.g. XRechnung, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD XML) against the
official CEN EN 16931 rules and, for XRechnung, the KoSIT XRechnung 3.0 rules. Returns valid, and every error with its rule ID
(e.g. BR-CO-10), a plain-English message, XPath and a fix hint. rules: auto | en16931 | xrechnung. Slovak sellers also get eFaktúra field
checks (FR SR transposition v1.13, warnings with ruleset SK-FS); Norwegian sellers get NO-LAW field checks. Peppol-specific rules are not checked yet.
For PDFs use the REST endpoint POST /einvoice/validate. fixes lists concrete fixes for the errors (path, current, suggested,
explanation, apply safe|amounts|manual). autofix=true applies the safe ones to a copy and returns it in autofix.xml with its new
result (the original is unchanged); allow_amount_changes=true also applies total fixes that change the amount due (reported).

allow_amount_changes.description: If true together with autofix, also apply fixes that change amounts (e.g. recomputed totals).
allow_amount_changes.title: Allow Amount Changes

autofix.description: If true, apply the safe fixes to a copy and return the fixed XML in autofix.xml (the input is never changed).
autofix.title: Autofix

rules.description: Rule set: 'auto' (detect from the invoice, default), 'en16931' or 'xrechnung'.
rules.title: Rules

xml.description: The e-invoice XML as text: UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII (XRechnung, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD XML).
xml.title: Xml
